items.desc: The home village gate of the wuxia world at dusk: a red-pillared wooden pavilion gate with tiled roof and two glowing paper lanterns at the bottom center, misty purple-blue mountains behind, a large pale full moon in a violet-orange evening sky, pine trees at the sides.
Chapter 1 'Dusty village yard': a humble mountain village at the foot of a mountain in warm late-afternoon sun, thatched-roof huts, a dirt path, dry grass and drifting dust, soft golden hills behind.

Chapter 2 'Tongtong inn': interior of a lively wuxia inn at night, warm lantern light, wooden beams, hanging red lanterns, shelves of wine jars, steam from a kitchen, polished round wooden tables in the distance.

Chapter 3 'Turtle market': a busy old stone-paved market street seen from above at a slight angle, colorful cloth awnings, stalls with goods, a stone turtle statue, warm daylight, banners without writing.

Chapter 4 'Kubi mountain bandit camp forest path': deep green bamboo forest on a mountain, tall bamboo stalks framing both sides, misty green ridges behind, floating fireflies, a wooden bandit palisade barely visible in the mist.
Chapter 5 'Logic academy': a serene Confucian academy hall of white marble and blue-grey tiles on a mountainside, scholar pavilions, pine trees, cool clear morning light with drifting clouds.

Chapter 6 'Murim alliance headquarters, the grand tournament': a majestic snowy mountain-top fortress of the martial-arts alliance with grand tiled roofs and banners without writing, frozen lake below, blue-white icy light, falling snow, aurora-like qi glow in the sky.
Packed brown dirt ground of a village yard with fine dust, a few tiny pebbles and sparse little grass tufts, rough and dry.
Glossy dark-honey lacquered wooden tabletop of an inn with fine wood grain, a few faint glistening oil sheens, warm reflections.
Old grey-beige square flagstone pavement of a market street, worn stone slabs with thin mortar lines, subtle moss in a few cracks.
Forest path of soft dark earth covered with scattered fallen bamboo and maple leaves in green, yellow and red, a little moss.
Polished pale white-and-grey veined marble floor slab, smooth and clean, soft cool sheen.
Frozen lake ice surface, pale blue-white clear ice with fine frost patterns, faint cracks and trapped bubbles, cold sheen.
A golden tournament trophy cup with two handles and a star on it (the duel arena).
A small wuxia bamboo-slip calendar / scroll calendar with a red seal stamp mark (daily attendance).
Green misty mountain peaks with a small red banner flag on the top and a dotted red path climbing up (the story journey).
A closed wooden treasure chest with golden metal bands and lock plate.
An open old martial-arts manual book with stitched binding and faint ink diagrams (the collection book).
A round gold East Asian coin with a square hole in the middle (currency).
A glossy round red elixir pill (dan) with a soft red glow inside the outline only.
A stack of wooden supply crates with a small blue flag on top (the storehouse).
Two round flat playing stones, one white and one black, overlapping slightly (free play).
A special ornate treasure chest glowing with golden light and little sparkles (the legendary dealer).
A sturdy bronze padlock, closed.
An ornate bronze hand mirror with a round polished glass (appearance / looks).
A folded paper letter envelope sealed with a red wax seal (mail).
A gold medal with a star in the middle hanging from a red and blue ribbon.
A small wooden board or paper list with three lines and green check marks (missions / quests).
A glowing black-and-white yin-yang taiji symbol with a soft blue qi aura inside the outline (inner energy).
Two ivory dice with red and black pips tumbling (drop chances).
A purple jigsaw puzzle piece with a small white playing stone on it (stone puzzles).
A three-step winners podium, the tallest middle step gold with the number 1 on it, the others silver and bronze.
A golden-orange phoenix-like flame bud rising, warm glow inside the outline (rebirth).
A steel-grey mechanical gear cog.
A red cloth money pouch tied with a golden cord, with a gold coin emblem on it (the general store).
A shiny silver sycee ingot (boat-shaped silver money).
A bright blue spirit flame (vital energy / stamina).
A plump bright golden five-pointed star.
A plump five-pointed star in dark brown-grey, dull and unlit (an empty rating star).
A clenched martial artist's fist wrapped with cloth, with small orange power marks (strength stats).
A red and gold heraldic shield-shaped clan token with a gold star in the middle.
A rolled-open paper scroll on wooden rods with a gold star painted on it (training points).
A wooden wing chun training dummy (mok-in-jang) with arms sticking out, with small orange impact marks.
An antique brass compass with a red and white needle (wandering the martial world).
A swirling grey-blue storm cloud with a few rain streaks and a small lightning bolt (heavenly weather).
A small rocky outcrop with a gnarled pine tree growing on it and a little bamboo shoot beside it (terrain features on the board).

Close-up of a martial artist's index finger, glowing with golden inner energy, flicking a glossy white go stone that smashes into a black go stone; the black stone cracks and flies away with sparks and a shockwave ring.

A glossy white go stone wrapped in a blazing golden-orange qi aura, shooting diagonally from lower left to upper right like a comet, slamming into a black go stone which shatters into fragments; motion streaks and ink splashes.

A heroic young wuxia swordsman's hand in a red sleeve, two fingers raised in a sword-finger gesture, a white go stone launching off the fingertip trailing golden fire, a black stone exploding in front of it; dramatic close-up.

ICONIC AND SIMPLE: one huge glossy white go stone in the exact center, outlined in a thick bright gold rim light, with a single clean golden index finger tip touching it from the lower left; behind it a single black go stone cracking in half with three big shards; background is a nearly flat deep crimson-to-black radial gradient with one bold golden circular shockwave ring. Very few elements, very large shapes, strong silhouette, no busy textures.

ICONIC AND SIMPLE: a big glossy white go stone flying from left to right with a short thick golden flame trail, hitting a big black go stone that bursts with a bold golden starburst; the two stones fill the middle of the icon; background is a calm deep ink-black with a subtle red glow and a faint golden circle. Very few elements, very large shapes, strong contrast, no busy textures.

A cute chibi young wuxia boy in a red robe with a topknot, grinning confidently, flicking a big round white go stone with his index finger across a wooden go board toward a big round black go stone that is flying away with a funny shocked face and little stars; small golden sparkle at the fingertip. Warm wooden board and soft red background.

Close up of a go board corner seen from slightly above: a big glossy white go stone with a determined cute face and a tiny red martial-arts headband bumping a big black go stone with a dizzy swirly-eyes face off the edge of the board, a cute chibi hand with a pointing finger just behind the white stone, comic impact star burst. Warm wood board, deep red background.

A cute chibi wuxia girl in a sky-blue robe with a ponytail and pink ribbon, winking, holding up her index finger ready to flick, a big round white go stone in front of her finger and a big round black go stone with a surprised face nearby on a wooden go board; heart and sparkle accents. Soft warm background.
A tiny chibi red squirrel martial-arts sidekick with a big fluffy tail and a little red headband, crouched ready to flick a small white go stone with its paw, energetic grin.
A chubby chibi green turtle guardian with a sturdy golden-patterned shell like a shield, wearing a tiny blue sash, standing proudly with arms crossed, calm confident smile.
An elegant chibi white crane with a red crown, wings slightly spread, wearing a tiny scholar hat, one wing pointing forward as if aiming, gentle wise smile.
A chibi white tiger cub with black stripes and bright blue eyes, fierce but cute expression, paw raised ready to strike, tiny golden bracelet, little fang showing.
A chibi golden eastern dragon (long body, tiny horns, whiskers, small cloud puffs) curled happily, holding a glowing white go stone like a pearl, sparkling eyes, majestic but adorable.
A cute golden paw print inside a small round jade badge (pet companions menu icon).

Chapter 7 'Scorching sand canyon': a vast red-gold desert canyon with towering wind-carved sandstone cliffs, a caravan road and a ruined fortress gate on the mesa, swirling sandstorm haze, blazing low sun.
Chapter 8 'Black Dragon pirate ship': a huge Chinese junk pirate ship with dark red ribbed sails on a stormy night sea, lanterns swinging, waves crashing, lightning far away.
Chapter 9 'Flame mountain lava cavern': a giant volcanic cavern with rivers of glowing lava, black basalt pillars, a red stone shrine on a ledge, floating embers and heat shimmer.
Chapter 10 'Heavenly temple of the Alkkagi god': a celestial golden temple floating above a sea of clouds at dawn, jade stairs, rainbow halos, cranes far away, sacred radiant light.
Hard-packed desert sandstone ground with fine wind ripples of red-gold sand, a few tiny pebbles and cracks.
Weathered dark wooden ship deck planks running straight, wet sheen from sea spray, iron nails, rope scuffs.
Cooled black volcanic basalt rock floor with thin glowing orange lava veins in the cracks, ash dust.
Polished pale jade and white cloud-marble temple floor with soft golden inlaid lines and faint drifting cloud wisps.
A round patch of swirling golden quicksand sinking in a spiral toward the center, darker in the middle, with a few sand grains.
A sturdy round wooden wine barrel seen from directly above: circular lid with iron hoops, wood planks and a cork plug.
A round swirling vortex of blue-white wind and cloud spinning in a spiral with bright streaks, seen from above.
A round pit of bubbling glowing orange-red lava surrounded by a rim of black cracked basalt, seen from above.
A puffy round soft white-gold cloud cushion with a gentle golden glow, seen from above.
A radiant golden starburst impact: sharp golden light rays, a bright white flash core, small sparkles, like a perfect martial-arts strike.
A stone shattering explosion: jagged grey and white stone shards and dust flying outward in all directions from a bright core.
A puff of swirling dust and ink smoke with small motion streaks bursting outward, like something falling off a ledge.
A blazing ring of red-orange flame qi with fiery streaks, like a burning combo aura.
A playful burst of four-leaf-like golden lucky sparkles and small gold coins confetti spiraling outward.
A swirling sphere of blue-violet inner qi energy with flowing ribbon streams and a glowing white core.
